dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical narrowing starting from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median intensity visible through moderate water turbidity.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey clusters distributed across the mid-section and posterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary light-grey baseline and faint darker mottled patches.

other_distinctive_markers: Centrally positioned, high-contrast dark oval blowhole visible on the anterior dorsal surface.
